_comment: Boundary manifest (US-SPEC-10 s7, US-10-R11), read by tools/boundary_check.mjs. Every directory directly under a root is a component and needs a class (core, app or private) and a role. core: the product, identical for every tenant. app: optional capability or application built on the core. private: a private plane that never ships (none in this repository).

core/_shared.role: test helpers shared by the core modules

core/auth.role: OWNER-AUTH-1: who is the owner is read from the repository, never typed. The person signs in with GitHub (one click, through the

core/claims.role: Claims (US-SPEC-08): exclusive time-limited claims, fences, secret lease, deploy lock, reaper, reconciliation hooks

core/conformance.role: Conformance (US-SPEC-00): the level declaration, the map from every requirement to the tests that prove it, and the

core/console-l3.role: Operator console L3 (US-SPEC-13, US-SPEC-18; issue #46): the fleet view over the L1 console. One state function feeds the

core/criticality.role: core/criticality: a deployment must reach the point where it builds itself with nobody prompting it. Two tick steps

core/docgate.role: Document gate: "if it is not in code, it does not exist". Every document is either traced to a work item or gets a recorded

core/doors.role: Doors for the console (US-SPEC-18/19): a first-run key shown once, and Cloudflare Access sign-in by verified JWT

core/elicit.role: Elicitation (US-SPEC-16, issue #60): the front door for a person who does not know what they do not know

core/export.role: Export before drop (US-01-R04). Migrations are additive; one that drops or rewrites data is applied only after every

core/kgraph.role: Knowledge graph with provenance whose gaps generate the next questions; tenant-agnostic

core/feed.role: Changelog feed rendered as RSS and JSON Feed, tenant-agnostic

core/outreach.role: Approval-gated, dry-run-by-default outreach outbox with sender identity, disclosure footer, suppression and caps

core/tenantstore.role: Sandboxed per-tenant store with hard read and write budgets, vector search and a spend probe (US-SPEC-25)

core/githubapp.role: One-click GitHub access (US-SPEC-18 door github-app-install). A GitHub App is created from a manifest, installed on

core/intent.role: Intent intake: a request from any client becomes one work item the loops act on, or a recorded non-action

core/lifecycle-gates.role: mode tailoring, iterations, status report, scope gate

core/migrations.role: the seed schema every module builds on

core/modelport.role: the Models port and the Role runtime port

core/observe.role: Observability: the organization sees itself. Ingest structured events, compute error ratio and latency per source, and raise one work item per degraded source

core/packs.role: capability packs and the outbound guard

core/principles.role: The principles register: the system's own memory of what autonomy means and what the owner has directed

core/sla.role: Service levels and the loops around them (US-SPEC-13 sections 4 and 5):

core/specloop.role: core/specloop: the specification-to-code loop. Nobody asks for a specified capability to be built: every tick this module

core/src.role: the tick, the console and the first-run flow of the seed

core/staff.role: virtual staff, their authority and their lane

core/steward.role: the item ledger mirrored to every tracker (US-SPEC-08)

core/test.role: tests of the seed and the separation guard

core/trust.role: trust ledger, ladder and interrupt gate

core/vault.role: The vault: where a secret a person pastes into the console lives, so no one has to open a terminal to set a Worker

core/walkthrough.role: First-run walkthrough, per-person profile, Elicitation Ask cards and the read-back screen (US-SPEC-18 sections 4, 5, 6;

core/yield.role: Yield and waste (cost per useful output). Ports: ctx = { db, now(), config, outputs?(days) }

packs/cloud.role: Cloudflare and Google Cloud through core/deploy

packs/drafts.role: plan, technical-description and legal-style drafts, draft-only

adapters/cloudflare.role: the Workers adapter: entry point, heartbeat, deployer and install adapter

adapters/gcp.role: the Cloud Run adapter, kept as proof of the portability seams

runtimes/python.role: the Python runtime of the platform

core/ignorance.role: Registry of known unknowns, red-team, inversion and pre-mortem passes, and a frontier of new questions; tenant-agnostic (IGN-1)

core/promote.role: Autonomous promotion: channel publishers, caps, kill switch, referral tuning, reach targets, idea intake; tenant-agnostic (PROMOTE-1)

core/access.role: Access preflight: probes the real state of every capability a tenant depends on

core/deploygate.role: Deploy gate: hash read-back of the stored module before a deploy counts as verified

core/benefitcost.role: Common-metric (WELLBY) benefit-cost engine with graded causal chains, higher-order effects and Monte Carlo uncertainty; tenant-agnostic

core/statements.role: Claims are code: a registry of published statements, each rendered from live config and bound to a probe of the real behaviour; page audit fails on unbound prose; tenant-agnostic
